properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, undated [likely fall 1936], on stationery from the Manila Hotel; includes description of challenges in negotiating contracts in Manila; mentions President Q. [Manuel Quezon], J.T.T. [Juan Trippe], Aranita, Captain [R.O.D.] Sullivan, Hal Sweet, [Bill] DeLima, [Paul] Groeger, [George] King.
